remarks:
Welcome to 31 Weber Ave, Buffalo, NY 14215—a beautifully renovated duplex offering an exceptional opportunity for both owner-occupants and investors. This move-in-ready property features 3 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms and thoughtfully updated to provide modern comfort and style. 
Step inside to discover bright, freshly finished interiors, updated kitchens with modern cabinetry and fixtures, renovated bathrooms with stylish tile work, new flooring throughout, and fresh neutral finishes that make each unit feel clean and inviting. The functional layouts maximize space and natural light, creating comfortable living environments for tenants or homeowners alike.
The exterior offers low-maintenance siding and a manageable lot, while the convenient Buffalo location provides easy access to schools, parks, shopping, restaurants, and major roadways.
Whether you're looking to expand your investment portfolio or live in, this turnkey duplex is a fantastic opportunity. Don't miss your chance to own this  fully updated beautiful Single-family house!
